verses.text: After Joshua died, Israel’s people asked Yahweh, ‘Who should go up first to fight the Canaanites for us?’ 🗣️
Yahweh said, ‘Judah goes first. Look, I’ve handed the land over to him.’ 👑
Judah told Simeon his brother, ‘Come fight with me in my land share, and I’ll come fight with you in yours.’ So Simeon went with him. 🤝
Judah went up, and Yahweh handed the Canaanites and Perizzites over to them. They struck down 10,000 men at Bezek. ⚔️
They found Adoni-bezek at Bezek and fought him there. They struck down the Canaanites and Perizzites. 🛡️
Adoni-bezek ran, but they chased him down, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes. ⚔️

Adoni-bezek said, ‘Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off used to pick up scraps under my table. What I did to them, God has done to me.’ They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there. ⚖️
Judah’s people fought Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the sword, and set the city on fire. 🔥
After that, Judah went down to fight the Canaanites living in the hill country, the South, and the lowlands. ⚔️
Judah went against the Canaanites living in Hebron, which used to be called Kiriath-arba. They struck down Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. 🏔️
From there he went up against the people of Debir, which used to be called Kiriath-sepher. 🗺️
Caleb said, ‘Whoever attacks Kiriath-sepher and takes it can marry my daughter Achsah.’ 🗣️
Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took the city, so Caleb gave him his daughter Achsah as his wife. 💍
When she arrived, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb asked her, ‘What would you like?’ 🫏
She told him, ‘Give me a blessing. You’ve given me land in the South, so give me springs of water too.’ Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs. 💧
Moses’ brother-in-law, the Kenite, and his descendants left the City of Palms with Judah’s people for Judah’s southern wilderness near Arad. They settled among the people there. 🏕️
Judah went with Simeon his brother. They struck the Canaanites living in Zephath and completely destroyed it. The city was renamed Hormah. ⚔️
Judah also took Gaza and its borderlands, Ashkelon and its borderlands, and Ekron and its borderlands. 🏙️
Yahweh was with Judah, and they drove out the hill-country people. But they couldn’t drive out the valley’s people, because they had iron chariots. 🛞
Hebron was given to Caleb, just as Moses had said, and Caleb drove out Anak’s three sons from there. 🏔️
Benjamin’s people didn’t drive the Jebusites out of Jerusalem. The Jebusites still live there among Benjamin’s people to this day. 🏙️
Joseph’s family also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them. 🛡️
Joseph’s family sent scouts to check out Bethel, which used to be called Luz. 🕵️
The scouts saw a man coming out of the city. They said to him, ‘Please show us the way into the city, and we’ll treat you well.’ 🗣️
He showed them the way in. They struck the city with the sword, but let the man and his whole family go. 🛡️
The man went to the Hittite land, built a city, and named it Luz. That’s still its name today. 🏙️

Manasseh’s people didn’t drive out the residents of Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Dor and its towns, Ibleam and its towns, or Megiddo and its towns. The Canaanites kept living in that land. 🏘️
When Israel got stronger, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but never fully drove them out. ⚠️
Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer. The Canaanites kept living there among them. 🏘️
Zebulun didn’t drive out the people of Kitron or Nahalol. The Canaanites stayed among them and became forced laborers. ⚠️
Asher didn’t drive out the people of Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, or Rehob. 🏘️
The Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the people of the land, because they didn’t drive them out. ⚠️
Naphtali didn’t drive out the people of Beth-shemesh or Beth-anath. They lived among the Canaanites there, though the people of those two towns became forced laborers. ⚠️
The Amorites pushed Dan’s people up into the hill country. They wouldn’t let them come down into the valley. 🛡️
The Amorites kept living on Mount Heres, in Aijalon and Shaalbim. But Joseph’s family gained the upper hand, and the Amorites became forced laborers. ⚔️
The Amorite border ran from the Akrabbim Pass, from the Rock, and upward. 🗺️
